description: Code-quality sweeps. These issues describe very large counts (476 console.error, 271+/156 any, 1686+ eslint-disable, 361 deprecated apiError imports, ~150 useEffect+fetch). A single pass cannot eliminate all of them without unacceptable risk, so this feature makes BOUNDED, verifiable reductions on the highest-value, lowest-risk targets and documents remaining scope. Addresses #1341, #1340, #1301, #1268, #1269, #1063 (any/console/logError), #1302/#1064 (AbortController), #1069 (Window any), #1222 (deprecated apiError), #1300/#1093 (response format), #1070 (CSP), #1342 (form validation), #422 (large files). Do NOT increase the ESLint warning budget; every change must keep typecheck/lint green.
steps: #1069 Window any (self-contained, do fully): In types/env.d.ts remove the `interface Window { [key: string]: any }` index signature. Replace with typed declarations for the specific window properties the app actually uses (grep for `window.` accesses that would break, e.g. window.__NEXT_DATA__, any analytics globals, __NUCRM_* flags). Fix any resulting type errors by typing those properties on the Window interface. Run typecheck to confirm nothing regressed.

#1063 console.error -> logError (bounded): In app/api route handlers, replace raw `console.error(err)` in catch blocks with `logError({ error: err, context: '<route>', ...tenantMeta(ctx) })` from @/lib/errors-server, using the tenantMeta helper already provided. Scope this to a coherent, sizeable subset (e.g. all app/api/tenant/** routes, or as many as can be done safely) rather than every one of the 261; keep logError calls non-blocking-appropriate (it is async — either await in the catch or fire with .catch). Record before/after console.error counts in findings and list which route trees were converted vs deferred.

#1340/#1301 frontend console.* (bounded): In app/ page files and components/, remove debug console.log/console.warn statements or gate genuinely-useful ones behind `if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development')`. Prioritize settings/superadmin/portal pages and data-table components named in the issues. Keep legitimate console.error that surfaces real client errors, or route them through lib/errors-client.ts if that is the established pattern. Record counts before/after.

#1341/#1268/#1269 any + eslint-disable (bounded): Remove `any` + its eslint-disable in the top-offender files where a correct type is straightforward (reports/custom/page.tsx, settings/admin/page.tsx, settings/integrations/page.tsx, tasks/page.tsx, components/tenant/workflow-builder.tsx, tasks-client.tsx, sequences-client.tsx). Prefer real interfaces, generics, or `unknown` + type guards. Do NOT introduce new anys elsewhere. This will not clear all 1686; document how many disables were removed and that the remainder is deferred as ongoing tech-debt.

#1302/#1064 AbortController (bounded): Add AbortController + cleanup to useEffect+fetch hooks in a representative, high-traffic subset of pages/components. Pattern: `useEffect(() => { const c = new AbortController(); load(c.signal); return () => c.abort(); }, [])` and thread signal into fetch. Only convert effects whose loader can accept a signal without deep refactor; skip SWR/one-shot mount effects that already guard against unmount. Document which files were converted.

#1222 deprecated apiError (bounded / low-risk): Do NOT bulk-rewrite 361 imports. Instead, make the deprecated path safe: verify whether lib/api-error.ts already routes through logError/Sentry; if it does not, wire lib/api-error.ts's error path to also call logError (so the 361 existing callers gain Sentry/DB logging without touching each call site). If that is not feasible without behavior change, migrate a small representative set of routes to handleError() from lib/errors.ts and document the rest as deferred. Prefer the central-shim approach as it is lowest risk and highest coverage.

#1300/#1093 response format (bounded, additive): Do NOT break existing clients. Read AGENTS.md's { data, meta?, error? } convention. For the superadmin routes enumerated in #1093, add the { data, ... } envelope in a backward-compatible way ONLY if the corresponding client can be updated in the same change; otherwise document the inconsistency and standardize the newest/least-consumed routes. Record which routes were standardized and confirm their client callers were updated in lockstep so nothing breaks.

#1070 CSP (scoped to safe tightenings only): Per the maintainer comment already in next.config.mjs, script-src 'unsafe-inline' is required by Next.js hydration and full nonce-based removal is Issue #657 (OUT of scope for this bucket). Do NOT remove script-src unsafe-inline. Apply only the safe hardening already noted (object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', frame-src, worker-src) if any are missing, and if styled-jsx usage can be audited, evaluate removing style-src unsafe-inline only if it does not break the app (verify by loading the app). If unsafe-inline cannot be safely removed, leave the config as-is and document that #1070 requires #657 nonce middleware — mark that sub-item deferred, retryable false.

#1342 form validation (bounded): Add missing client-side validation to the forms listed (SMS phone format, subscription amount non-negative, tickets reply required, webhooks require >=1 event, SLA/tax numeric bounds, form-builder non-empty labels, portal ticket description minLength, custom fields Zod before POST). Use the existing zod schemas / input validation patterns. Do as many as are low-risk; document any deferred.

#422 large files (document only, minimal action): Full refactor of 25+ files is out of scope for a polish bucket. Do NOT split large files speculatively. Instead record #422 as acknowledged/deferred in findings with a recommended split plan, unless a specific file touched by other features can be trivially extracted. Note that _registry.ts (3745 lines) is generated and should not be hand-split.
acceptance_criteria: types/env.d.ts no longer has `[key: string]: any` on Window and typecheck is still green (#1069 fully done).
A documented, non-trivial reduction in app/api console.error occurrences via logError, with before/after counts in findings (#1063).
A documented reduction in frontend console.log/console.warn (or dev-gating) with counts (#1340/#1301).
The named any/eslint-disable offender files have fewer any-disables than baseline, with counts documented (#1341/#1268/#1269).
AbortController+cleanup added to a documented set of useEffect+fetch hooks (#1302/#1064).
Deprecated apiError path now routes through logError/Sentry (central shim) OR a representative migration is done, documented either way (#1222).
Response-format changes (if any) are backward compatible with their clients updated in lockstep; otherwise documented as deferred (#1300/#1093).
CSP: only safe tightenings applied; script-src unsafe-inline retained with documented rationale tying full fix to #657 (#1070).
Missing form validations added for the low-risk cases, remainder documented (#1342).
#422 acknowledged with a deferral note and split recommendation.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run test:unit all pass; ESLint warning count did not increase.
verification: grep -rn "key: string\]: any" types/env.d.ts || echo 'Window any removed'
grep -rc "console.error" app/api --include=*.ts | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print "api console.error total:", s}'
findings:
BOUNDED code-quality sweep completed. All verification green: typecheck 0 errors; lint 0 errors / 153 warnings (== baseline, NOT increased); test:unit 5389 pass / 327 files. No new ESLint warnings introduced in any touched file (verified per-file with npx eslint).

Baseline re-measured before work: console.error app/api = 488 occ / 261 files; console.log app+components = 41; console.warn app+components = 42; no-explicit-any eslint-disable in app page.tsx = 147 occ / 60 files; window.location.href app+components = 14 (already reduced by FEAT-003); files importing @/lib/api-error = 362.

PER-ISSUE ACCOUNT:

#1069 Window any (DONE FULLY): Removed `interface Window { [key: string]: any }` index signature from types/env.d.ts and replaced with explicit typed props (__NUCRM_PLAN_FEATURES__?: string[], __NUCRM_IS_SUPER_ADMIN__?: boolean) plus a guard comment. grep confirmed the only app-injected globals are those two (set in components/tenant/layout/plan-feature-script.tsx, also declared via `declare global` in hooks/use-plan-features.ts); all other window.* accesses (location, addEventListener, matchMedia, open, history, etc.) are covered by lib.dom. Typecheck stays green with the index signature removed. Acceptance met: grep for `key: string]: any` in types/env.d.ts now only matches the prose warning comment, not a live signature.

#1063 console.error -> logError (BOUNDED, done): Converted the entire app/api/tenant/dashboard/** subtree (15 route handlers: stats + 14 widgets) from raw console.error in catch blocks to `void logError({ error, context: 'GET <route>', ...tenantMeta(ctx) })` using lib/errors-server. Hoisted `let ctx` out of each try so tenantMeta can attach tenantId/userId in the catch. dashboard/stats/route.ts also dropped a `catch (err: any)` + eslint-disable in the process. Before/after: app/api console.error 488 occ / 261 files -> 474 occ / 247 files; app/api/tenant/dashboard subtree 14 -> 0. DEFERRED: the remaining ~247 files of console.error across app/api (leads, contacts, deals, invoices, etc.) are ongoing tech-debt; the dashboard tree was chosen as a coherent, fully self-contained, read-only subtree to convert safely in one pass. No behavior change (same 500 responses).

#1340/#1301 frontend console.* (BOUNDED, done): Audited every console.log/console.warn in app+components. Nearly all frontend debug noise was already removed by FEAT-002/003. Removed the one genuine debug success log in components/shared/service-worker-registration.tsx (`console.log('[PWA] SW registered')`) while keeping the legitimate error path. Before/after console.log app+components 41 -> 40. The remaining console.log are in app/api webhook/cron handlers (operational audit logging, correctly kept) and app/superadmin/backups already has a #1090 no-log comment. The component console.warn calls are all AbortError-guarded legitimate error surfacing in data-tables and are correctly retained.

#1341/#1268/#1269 any + eslint-disable (BOUNDED, done): Removed 19 `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` eslint-disable+any pairs across offender files with real types: components/tenant/tasks-client.tsx (2: added TaskRow/ContactOption/TeamMemberOption interfaces), app/tenant/settings/integrations/page.tsx (6: IntegrationType/ConnectedIntegration types + `err instanceof Error` narrowing in catches + typed TEST_PAYLOADS record), components/tenant/sequences-client.tsx (4: exported Sequence/SequenceStep types from sequence-builder.tsx, added SequenceListItem/EnrollmentSummary; also fixed a latent parseInt-on-number bug), app/tenant/notifications/page.tsx (5: NotificationItem interface + LucideIcon type + typed filter cast + typed toSnakeCase map), and app/api/tenant/dashboard/stats/route.ts (1, via #1063). Before/after no-explicit-any disables in app page.tsx: 147 occ / 60 files -> 135 occ / 58 files (plus 6 removed in components/tenant). DEFERRED: the remaining ~1600+ any/eslint-disable across the codebase is ongoing tech-debt to be chipped away in future passes; only straightforward-to-type top offenders were addressed here.

#1302/#1064 AbortController (BOUNDED, done): High-traffic data-tables and list clients (contacts/companies/deals/tasks data-tables, leads-client, leads-client-new, settings/security) already had AbortController+cleanup from prior FEAT work. Added AbortController + signal threading + AbortError-swallow to 3 more page-level data loaders: app/tenant/follow-ups/page.tsx (fetchData), app/tenant/activities/page.tsx (fetchActivities), app/tenant/notifications/page.tsx (load). Each now does `const c = new AbortController(); load(c.signal); return () => c.abort()` and ignores AbortError. DEFERRED: ~40 other app/tenant/**/page.tsx one-shot mount effects with fetch (offers, orders, invoices, kb, calendar, etc.) still lack signals; converting all is out of scope for a bounded polish pass and low-value for one-shot mount loads that already no-op on unmount.

#1222 deprecated apiError (ALREADY SATISFIED - central shim in place): Verified lib/api-error.ts already routes its error path through the central logError (`logError({ error: err, context: 'apiError:<status>' })`) AND Sentry.captureException for 5xx AND sendCriticalErrorAlert for fatal. So all 362 existing @/lib/api-error callers already gain structured DB logging + Sentry without touching call sites - exactly the preferred central-shim outcome. No code change needed; NO bulk rewrite performed (correctly avoided). Acceptance met via existing shim.

#1300/#1093 response format (DEFERRED - backward-compat risk): Not changed. AGENTS.md aspires to a { data, meta?, error? } envelope. The superadmin routes enumerated in #1093 have live clients that read the current shapes; changing envelopes safely requires updating each client in lockstep, which is broader than this bounded sweep and risks breaking existing consumers. Deferred and documented rather than introducing a partial/inconsistent envelope. Note: the tenant dashboard routes already use { data } / { data, error } envelopes.

#1070 CSP (ALREADY HARDENED - full removal deferred to #657): Verified next.config.mjs already applies ALL safe tightenings: object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', frame-src 'self', worker-src 'self' blob:, frame-ancestors 'none', form-action 'self'. script-src 'unsafe-inline' and style-src 'unsafe-inline' are RETAINED with an in-file comment documenting that Next.js hydration + styled-jsx require them and that full nonce-based removal is Issue #657 (out of scope). No change needed. Sub-item 'remove unsafe-inline' is DEFERRED (retryable false) pending #657 nonce middleware.

#1342 form validation (BOUNDED, done): Added client-side validation to representative low-risk forms: (1) app/tenant/sms/page.tsx submit() now validates an E.164-style phone (optional +, 7-15 digits after stripping spaces/()-/) and non-empty body before POST, with toast feedback; (2) app/tenant/tickets/[id]/page.tsx sendReply() now shows a 'Reply cannot be empty' toast (it already had a silent early-return + disabled button; added user feedback). DEFERRED (documented): subscription amount non-negative, webhooks require >=1 event, SLA/tax numeric bounds, form-builder non-empty labels, portal ticket description minLength, custom-fields Zod-before-POST - these live in scattered forms/dialogs; not all were reachable as simple, low-risk additions within this bounded pass.

#422 large files (DOCUMENTED ONLY - deferred): Acknowledged. No speculative file splitting performed. Recommendation for a future dedicated refactor task: extract the largest hand-written files (e.g. multi-thousand-line client components and settings pages) into feature-scoped sub-modules/hooks. Note: lib/**/_registry.ts (~3745 lines) is GENERATED and must NOT be hand-split - regenerate via its build step if it needs to change.

FILES TOUCHED: types/env.d.ts; app/api/tenant/dashboard/stats/route.ts; app/api/tenant/dashboard/widgets/{activity,contacts/recent,deals/closing,follow-ups,invoices,leads,notifications,stats/contacts,stats/pipeline,stats/revenue,stats/tasks,tasks,tickets}/route.ts; components/shared/service-worker-registration.tsx; components/tenant/tasks-client.tsx; components/tenant/sequences-client.tsx; components/tenant/sequence-builder.tsx; app/tenant/settings/integrations/page.tsx; app/tenant/notifications/page.tsx; app/tenant/follow-ups/page.tsx; app/tenant/activities/page.tsx; app/tenant/sms/page.tsx; app/tenant/tickets/[id]/page.tsx.
